prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Grid Selection Layout for Pet Picker: Rebuild the pet choice screen into a 2x2 grid layout displaying pet avatars and personalities side by side.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Select a friend to join your workspace."}}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Personality Summary Screen: Insert a new screen right after pet selection showing an expanded preview and trait list of the chosen pet before photo customization.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "new_pet_summary", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_summary": {"headline": "Meet Your New Companion", "body": "Here are the unique habits and traits of your chosen pet.", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:pet_preview", "style": "playful"}]}}
2: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign In To Final Onboarding Step: Move the sign-in prompt to after pet waiting screen, right before the final home introduction.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "sign_in", "home_intro"]}
3: [finish, new_flow] Interactive First Desktop Interaction Flow: Transform the home intro screen into a full-stage layout with interactive welcome mascot call-to-actions.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Welcome Your Pet to Desktop", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:welcome_pet", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Say Hello", "action": "next", "style": "rounded"}]}}
4: [choose_path, layout] Spotlight Layout for Path Selection: Switch the choose path screen layout to spotlight style focusing on one path at a time.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Select How You Would Like to Begin"}}
5: [sign_in, hint] Account Sign In Persistence Warning: Add a prominent account persistence hint on the sign-in screen explaining account syncing.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your main account to keep and sync your pets across desktop sessions."}}
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop Spawn Progress Indicator: Enable visible progress bar and time estimate on the waiting screen while desktop pet resources load.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "headline": "Preparing Your Pet Desktop Assets"}}
7: [adoption, incentive] Certificate Adoption Verification Badge: Display an official adoption badge graphic on the adoption certificate screen.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Official Companion Adoption", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [home, notification] Onboarding Completion Ready Alert: Enable desktop notification trigger on the waiting screen to alert users when asset loading completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "body": "We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready!"}}
9: [finish, copy] Desktop Controls Quick Reference Headline: Update home intro headline and body text to explain basic desktop controls (right-click to interact or hide).
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Companion is Ready! Right-Click to Control", "body": "Right-click your pet on the desktop at any time to chat, hide, feed, or change preferences."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the pet selection screen into a grid layout maintains its core functionality while staying within onboarding.
Adding a pet summary screen is a permitted onboarding addition and keeps all required onboarding steps intact.
Reordering sign-in to after the waiting step is explicitly allowed by rule 4, and all required steps remain.
Modifying the home intro overlay layout and components is allowed since home_intro is part of onboarding.
Updating the layout of the path selection screen remains within onboarding guidelines while preserving choice.
Adding persistent sign-in informational text provides context without asking for new personal data or violating fair design.
Showing a progress indicator for actual asset loading is permitted as a real wait time indicator.
Adding an official adoption badge to the certificate maintains the job of the screen and stays inside onboarding.
Enabling notification triggers on the waiting screen is explicitly allowed under onboarding notification rules.
Updating instructional copy on the home intro screen stays within allowed onboarding modifications.
